Name: Scroll of Awakening
Description: Use on a white item: adds a random prefix or suffix and turns the item blue.

Name: Scroll of Sharpening
Description: Use on a blue item: adds a prefix modifier (blue items hold at most 2 modifiers).

Name: Scroll of Warding
Description: Use on a blue item: adds a suffix modifier (blue items hold at most 2 modifiers).

Name: Scroll of Exaltation
Description: Use on a gold item: adds a random modifier.

Name: Greater Scroll of Sharpening
Description: Use on a gold item: adds a prefix modifier.

Name: Greater Scroll of Warding
Description: Use on a gold item: adds a suffix modifier.

Name: Scroll of Sealing
Description: Use on a gold item: +1 prefix and +1 suffix slot and adds a random modifier — but Seals the item against any further modification.

Name: Scroll of Cleansing
Description: Use on any item: removes a random modifier. A blue item stripped of all modifiers turns white again.

Name: Scroll of Chaos
Description: Use on any item: removes a random modifier, then adds a random one.

Name: Chaotic Scroll of Sharpening
Description: Use on any item: removes a random modifier and adds a prefix. If the prefixes are full, the removed modifier is a prefix.

Name: Chaotic Scroll of Warding
Description: Use on any item: removes a random modifier and adds a suffix. If the suffixes are full, the removed modifier is a suffix.
